540.title: Let customers download their invoice list
540.body:
## Problem

Customers copy invoices into spreadsheets by hand.

## Scope

Add a CSV download of the invoice list.

## Verification

- A unit test shows the CSV header and one row.
- The invoice list shows a download button.

541.title: Pagination drops the last invoice on the final page
541.body:
## Problem

`pageBounds` returns an inclusive end.

## Scope

Return an exclusive end from `pageBounds` in `app/lib/pagination.ts`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows page 2 of 15 invoices ending at 15.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
